name: Off Menu with Ed Gamble and James Acaster
description: Comedians Ed Gamble and James Acaster invite special guests into their magical restaurant to each choose their favourite starter, main course, side dish, dessert and drink. Ever wanted to eat your dream meal? It's time…

source.retrievedVia: Feed URL from the official Apple Podcasts lookup API; RSS snapshot fetched through a scraping service (the build container cannot reach feed hosts directly)
source.note: Most recent 500 items analyzed; older items (0) are read only to exclude past guests. Guest names come from a generic, conservative title rule (core/extract-generic.ts, confidence "low"); a spot check of 36 extractions found 3 non-person phrases.
